title: Simple Earn Agreement
notes: First-party agreement for HTX Earn flexible and fixed-term products. It contains broad investment-risk disclosures and documents borrowing-demand matching for flexible subscriptions.

title: Beginner's Guide to HTX Earn
notes: First-party guide showing that HTX Earn includes flexible and fixed deposit products as well as other product families; the canonical record is intentionally limited to Simple Earn flexible/fixed products.

title: New Listings on HTX Earn: Flexible Products for TNSR, SAGA, and MASA
notes: First-party announcement explicitly directs app users to Earn > Simple Earn and documents flexible product mechanics.

notes: Current first-party evidence confirming Flexible Earn operation in 2026, including hourly accrual and redemption mechanics.

title: New Coins Added in CoinEx Financial Account
notes: First-party evidence that the product was still named Financial Account on 30 July 2025 and allocated a portion of margin-borrowing interest to users.

title: Introduction to Flexible Savings
notes: First-party help page documenting Flexible Savings, daily compound interest and yields linked to CoinEx Margin Trading/Loans borrowing rates with CoinEx subsidies.

title: CoinEx Flexible Savings Product Upgraded
notes: First-party product-upgrade notice using the Flexible Savings name and describing floating APY, flexible access and borrowing-linked yield mechanics.

title: New Coin GRAM Added in CoinEx Flexible Savings
notes: Current first-party evidence confirming Flexible Savings operation in 2026 and warning that redemption can be delayed when idle Flexible Savings assets are insufficient until borrowers return coins.
